title: AcademicBehaviorAnalysisContract
description: Contract schema for root-cause diagnosis of agent behavior derived strictly from observable trajectories without private chain-of-thought tokens.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this behavior analysis report (e.g. BAN-20260919-001).

trigger_event_id.description: Pointer to the triggering event ID (e.g. EVT-20260919-0001 or FDB-20260919-0001).

target_agent.description: Cognitive agent responsible for the observed defect.

task_context.description: Context of the task being executed when failure occurred.

trajectory_id.description: Pointer to the observable trajectory record on disk.

failure_signature.description: Categorized defect signature (e.g. REPORTING_P_ZERO, MISSING_OMML_MATH, UNJUSTIFIED_MODEL_SELECTION, SYNTHETIC_INTEGERS_IN_PRODUCTION).

root_cause_diagnosis.description: Objective explanation of why the failure occurred based strictly on observable actions.

prescribed_behavior.description: Specific corrective behavior that should be performed instead.
